title: Alternatives to Planon for real estate development management
summary: What Planon's development management product, Reaforce, covers, what real estate development management software does, and the alternatives developers evaluate in the United States.
body_markdown:
Real estate development management software gives owners, developers, and asset managers one place to manage the budget, costs, capital, and schedule of every project they develop. Teams use it to replace spreadsheets with live budgets, forecasts, and portfolio reporting. Developers evaluating Planon often compare it against software built specifically for this category.


## What Planon is


**Planon is an integrated workplace management system vendor whose software spans facilities management, real estate management, space and workplace management, asset and maintenance management, and energy and sustainability management.**


Planon's site also lists campus management, field services, lease accounting, and Planon for SAP. Its commercial real estate line includes portfolio and investment management, property management, development management, and project control.


## Where development management sits inside Planon


**Planon's development management product, Reaforce, is one module inside Planon's commercial real estate line, alongside portfolio and investment management, property management, and project control.**


Reaforce was developed by Reasult B.V., founded in 2000 and headquartered in Ede, the Netherlands. Planon announced a majority stake in Reasult on January 20, 2021.


**Planon's development management product has a published customer base concentrated in the Dutch and German speaking markets.** When Planon announced its acquisition of Reasult in January 2021, it described the software as used by real estate developers, asset managers, and housing corporations in the Dutch and German speaking markets. Planon markets development management on its United States website. As of September 2026, none of the 34 case study pages on Planon's United States website mention development management or Reaforce. Its published United States case studies cover facilities management, campus management, and space management.


Planon's United States development management page describes five modules: cash flow planning, scenario planning, project control, finance, and risk management. The capabilities it describes center on financial planning: forecasting and managing project finances across the development process, modeling market conditions to anticipate outcomes, overseeing project timelines and budgets, financial modeling for project financing, and identifying risks to project viability. Planon's development management pages do not describe draw packaging, pay applications, lien waivers, vendor document intake, or lender requirements.


## What real estate development management software does


**Real estate development management software manages the financial and operational side of a development project from pre-development through stabilization: live budgets, anticipated cost reports, cash flow forecasting, capital structure, portfolio visibility, vendor management, milestone tracking, and draw packaging.**


### Live budgets


A live budget updates as contracts, change orders, and invoices are recorded, rather than being rebuilt in a spreadsheet each month. Real estate development management software keeps the budget current at the line-item level, with a history of every budget adjustment. Teams see the current state of every project without reconciling files.


### Anticipated cost reports


An anticipated cost report shows what a project is expected to cost at completion, combining committed contracts, pending change orders, and exposure not yet under contract. Real estate development management software produces these reports continuously and alerts teams when a line item is trending over budget. This is the report owners and investors ask for when they want to know where a project is expected to land.


### Cash flow forecasting


Cash flow forecasting projects when money will be spent and when capital will be needed, by project and across a portfolio. Real estate development management software models spend over time so teams can plan equity calls and draw timing before they are urgent.


### Capital structure and funding sources


Development projects are funded by a mix of equity, construction loans, and other sources, each with its own rules for how and when it is drawn. Real estate development management software tracks each funding source and how costs are allocated across the capital structure. Teams know which source is funding which cost at any point in the project.


### Portfolio visibility


Portfolio visibility gives leadership a single view of cost, schedule, and milestone status across every active project. Real estate development management software rolls project data up into portfolio reporting, so executives do not wait on project teams to assemble updates.


### Pre-development


Pre-development covers the budget and costs a project incurs before construction begins, including design, entitlements, and consultant fees. Real estate development management software tracks these costs from the start, so the project budget carries a complete history when construction begins.


### Vendor management


Vendor management tracks contracts, invoices, and compliance documents for every vendor on a project. Real estate development management software reports vendor-level cost and performance across projects, so teams can compare how vendors perform over time.


### Milestone tracking


Milestone tracking follows the key dates of a project and flags when the schedule deviates. Real estate development management software alerts teams to schedule changes that will affect cost or funding timing.


### Draw packaging


Draw packaging assembles the invoices, pay applications, lien waivers, and supporting documents a lender requires to fund a draw. Real estate development management software reads incoming documents, flags anything missing, and assembles the package ready to send.


## Alternatives for real estate development management


### Rabbet Development


**Rabbet Development is real estate development management software for owners, developers, and asset managers.**


Rabbet Development keeps a live budget for every project, updated as contracts, change orders, and invoices are recorded. Rabbet Development produces anticipated cost reports and alerts teams when a line item is trending over budget. Rabbet Development forecasts cash flow by project and across the portfolio.


Rabbet Development tracks each project's funding sources and how costs are allocated across the capital structure. Rabbet Development gives leadership portfolio visibility into cost, schedule, and milestone status across every active project. Rabbet Development tracks pre-development costs, vendor-level cost and performance across projects, and milestones, with alerts when a schedule deviates.


Rabbet Development reads incoming invoices and pay applications, flags missing documents, and assembles draw packages ready to send to the lender. Developers using Rabbet get funded 6 days faster, according to Rabbet's State of Construction Finance 2025 report. Rabbet supports more than $160B in real estate assets.


### Northspyre


**Northspyre describes itself on its homepage as real estate development management software.**


Northspyre's site describes a platform for managing deal, project, and portfolio data in one place, with real-time data and predictive insights for development teams. Its homepage references pre-development and positions the product across the development strategy end to end. Northspyre is strongest for teams that want deal pipeline and project data managed together.


## Adjacent tools sometimes evaluated


Some developers evaluate tools from neighboring categories alongside real estate development management software. These tools serve different buyers and solve different problems.


### Ingenious.Build


**Ingenious.Build describes itself as construction project management software.** Its site describes a platform that connects owners, developers, general contractors, and owner's representatives, covering financials, project management, construction administration, capital planning, and reporting from preconstruction through closeout.


### Procore


**Procore describes itself as construction project management software.** Its site describes connecting field and office teams, tracking project progress, and managing workflows in real time.


### Acumatica


**Acumatica describes itself as cloud ERP software.** It markets a construction edition as construction ERP software for builders and contractors, including job costing.

As of September 2026, none of the 34 case study pages on Planon's United States website mention development management or Reaforce. Its published United States case studies cover facilities management, campus management, and space management.


### What are the alternatives to Planon for real estate development management in the United States?
